Title: Scaffold Pango monorepo using shadcn monorepo template
Description: Initialize repository using shadcn monorepo template, pnpm workspaces, and Turborepo.
Acceptance Criteria: Monorepo initializes locally; pnpm install succeeds; pnpm dev runs web app; README and docs are committed.

Title: Add Pango domain package structure
Description: Add domain, db, validators, auth, events, integrations, and utils packages.
Acceptance Criteria: Each package has package.json, src/index.ts, and TypeScript config.

Title: Configure root scripts and Turborepo pipeline
Description: Configure dev/build/lint/typecheck/format scripts and Turbo tasks.
Acceptance Criteria: Root scripts exist; Turborepo tasks are configured.

Title: Set up initial GitHub Actions CI
Description: Add initial CI workflow for install, format, lint, typecheck, and build.
Acceptance Criteria: CI runs on PRs and pushes to main; Prisma checks excluded until Prisma exists.

Title: Configure branch protection and PR workflow
Description: Protect main and require CI checks before merging.
Acceptance Criteria: Main is protected; PRs required; CI must pass.

Title: Add minimum coding documentation set
Description: Add README and docs directory with minimum coding docs.
Acceptance Criteria: Docs exist under docs; root README links to docs index.

Title: Install and configure Prisma package
Description: Install Prisma and configure packages/db.
Acceptance Criteria: Prisma schema exists; db:validate and db:generate work.

Title: Create initial Prisma schema for Pango MVP
Description: Create core data models for accounts, properties, tenants, invoices, payments, receipts, maintenance, logs.
Acceptance Criteria: Core models exist; money fields use integer minor units; account-scoped tables include accountId.

Title: Add database seed script
Description: Create demo seed data for local development.
Acceptance Criteria: Seed creates demo landlord, property, units, tenants, invoices, partial payment, and maintenance request.

Title: Implement actor context and permission helpers
Description: Implement server-side actor/account resolution and permission helpers.
Acceptance Criteria: Current user/account resolved server-side; client accountId not trusted; landlord/tenant/admin helpers exist.

Title: Configure authentication provider
Description: Set up auth provider and account/workspace creation.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord can sign up/sign in; server session available; new landlord creates account.

Title: Build landlord dashboard shell
Description: Build dashboard layout and navigation.
Acceptance Criteria: Dashboard layout exists; nav includes core landlord sections.

Title: Implement property creation flow
Description: Create property form, action, service, and audit log.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord can create account-scoped property; audit log is written.

Title: Implement unit creation flow
Description: Create unit form, action, service, and validations.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord can create units; rent/deposit/status captured; unit names unique per property.

Title: Implement tenant and tenancy creation flow
Description: Add tenant and assign to unit through active tenancy and rent schedule.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can be assigned; tenancy and schedule created; unit becomes occupied; uniqueness enforced.

Title: Build rent roll table
Description: Create a table of properties, units, tenants, rent, and status.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord sees rent roll table with property/unit/tenant/rent/status.

Title: Implement invoice generation service
Description: Generate invoices for active tenancies.
Acceptance Criteria: Duplicate invoice for same tenancy/billing month blocked; amount copies rent schedule.

Title: Build invoice list and detail pages
Description: Display invoices and balances.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord sees invoices by status, tenant, property, unit, amount, due date, and balance.

Title: Implement manual payment recording service
Description: Record manual rent payments transactionally.
Acceptance Criteria: Payment updates invoice paid/balance/status; duplicate M-Pesa references blocked.

Title: Build payment recording UI
Description: Create form for manual payment recording.
Acceptance Criteria: Form validates amount, method, date, reference; partial payments supported.

Title: Implement receipt generation service
Description: Generate immutable receipts for completed payments.
Acceptance Criteria: Receipt generated; number unique; receipt immutable.

Title: Build arrears dashboard
Description: Show overdue and partial invoices.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord sees tenant, unit, amount due, due date, days overdue.

Title: Implement overdue invoice job
Description: Daily job marks invoices overdue.
Acceptance Criteria: Open/partial invoices past due marked overdue; paid/cancelled ignored.

Title: Implement SMS notification abstraction
Description: Create SMS provider interface and mock provider.
Acceptance Criteria: Interface and mock provider exist; NotificationLog records attempts.

Title: Implement manual rent reminder
Description: Send reminder for unpaid invoice.
Acceptance Criteria: No reminders for paid invoices; duplicate same-day reminders blocked.

Title: Build rent collection report
Description: Report completed rent payments by date range/property.
Acceptance Criteria: Report shows completed payments filtered by date and property.

Title: Build tax-readiness report
Description: Report gross completed rent payments and tax-readiness disclaimer.
Acceptance Criteria: Report uses gross completed payments; expenses not deducted; disclaimer included.

Title: Implement tenant portal shell
Description: Create minimal tenant portal layout.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant accesses home, payments, receipts, maintenance; no landlord access.

Title: Implement tenant balance view
Description: Show tenant unpaid invoices and payment history.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant sees current unpaid invoices and payment history.

Title: Implement tenant receipt view
Description: Show tenant receipts.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can view/download issued receipts.

Title: Implement maintenance request creation
Description: Tenant submits maintenance request.
Acceptance Criteria: Tenant can submit title/category/description/attachment for active tenancy.

Title: Build landlord maintenance queue
Description: Landlord views and updates maintenance requests.
Acceptance Criteria: Landlord can view, filter, update statuses.

Title: Build admin dashboard shell
Description: Create admin dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can view accounts, users, payments, and webhook events.

Title: Implement audit log viewer
Description: Admin can inspect audit logs.
Acceptance Criteria: Sensitive/financial actions are visible.

Title: Add Sentry error monitoring
Description: Configure Sentry for web app.
Acceptance Criteria: Errors are reported in staging/production.

Title: Add security review checklist
Description: Create security checklist.
Acceptance Criteria: Checklist covers tenant isolation, payments, receipts, uploads, admin actions.

Title: Create beta release checklist
Description: Create beta release checklist.
Acceptance Criteria: Checklist covers env vars, migrations, smoke tests, backups, rollback.

Title: Create payment provider abstraction
Description: Define PaymentProvider interface and mock provider.
Acceptance Criteria: Interface and mock provider exist; domain does not directly depend on Daraja.

Title: Add PaymentTransaction model and service
Description: Track external payment attempts.
Acceptance Criteria: Payment attempts recorded; CheckoutRequestID uniqueness enforced.

Title: Build M-Pesa callback route handler
Description: Create route to store raw webhook and enqueue job.
Acceptance Criteria: Payload stored; job enqueued; no full business logic inline.

Title: Build M-Pesa callback processor job
Description: Process callback idempotently.
Acceptance Criteria: Success creates/applies payment; failed/cancelled updates transaction status.
